messages:
jamie.infra: FYI onboarding in eu-west-1 is stalling — new batch of nodes failing healthchecks after firewall rollout. seeing repeated KMS decrypt timeouts in the bootstrap logs.

marta.sre: ugh. is that the flowlogs/sampling change from this morning?

ryan.platform: yep, firewall rule DFZ-2026-01 went live 06:12 UTC, it tightened outbound to the audit shipper endpoints. should have allowed the keystore, but looks like NAT egress path is hitting a proxy that doesn't forward subnets correctly.

jamie.infra: logs: ``ERROR: keystore: decrypt failure: context deadline exceeded`` then ``proxy 10.8.2.14: upstream connect failed``. Tried rolling back the rule but rollout service reported success (no errors) — weird mismatch.

marta.sre: can you paste the short iptables/snippet from the host that shows proxy target? also which keystore (privnet vs shared-keystore)?

jamie.infra: host snippet: ```curl -v https://keystore.internal.redwood/eu/decrypt --interface 10.8.2.14``` -> hangs. proxy env: HTTP_PROXY set to http://10.8.2.14:3128. Keystore is the private keystore (privnet), path uses privatelink.

leila.security: pinging in. We tightened egress to reduce audit log exfil risk. We had a gap where flowlogs were landing in third-party S3 and we need to force shipper to our SIEM. The change was scoped to shipper CIDRs but looks like the proxy CIDR was inadvertently replaced with a deny rule.

ryan.platform: confirmed: terraform plan had a variable that defaulted to 0.0.0.0/0 during staging merge, then later a followup changed it to shipper-only but missed the proxy-team CIDR. So nodes lost outbound to the keystore through proxy.

marta.sre: impact: onboarding queues backlogged, ~120 nodes waiting, GPU pool not scaling; customers on Dedicated may see provisioning delays. Cost angle: keeping audit logs in high-res for troubleshooting will bump analytics costs if we increase retention.

jamie.infra: mitigation proposal: 1) temporary allowlist for proxy CIDR 10.8.0.0/16 in the egress policy; 2) short-lived IAM role that allows keystore decrypt from onboarding agents (scoped to instance profile); 3) quick postmortem to revert allowed CIDR once proxy is patched.

leila.security: we can do (1) for 2 hours with monitoring. (2) is trickier — workforce policy requires approval for new decrypt permissions. Acceptable if it's timeboxed and audited.

ryan.platform: I can push the CIDR allow rule via emergency toggle (fast path) and add an event tag so audit logs highlight the change. command: ``./infra-toggle egress-override --cidr 10.8.0.0/16 --ttl 2h --reason "onboard keystore path"``

ops-bot: deploy-bot: change requested by ryan.platform scheduled at 3555556700, approver: leila.security.

leila.security: approved, please include a list of the instances that used the fallback path and an entry in the keystore-access audit for the window. we want to avoid broad IAM rollouts.

marta.sre: after toggle: nodes started to proceed. Observed healthcheck success rate go from 42% -> 96% over ~8 minutes. Still seeing a handful (5-7) with kv cache errors, investigating.

jamie.infra: can we add a lightweight loghook to capture the decrypt request/response latency for the next 6 hours and ship to a limited retention bucket (7 days) so we can avoid touching long-term analytics quotas?

leila.security: yes, scope to 7 days is fine. add encryption with the existing keystore CMK and tag with incident id. Security will run expedited audit.

ryan.platform: I'll also open a quick terraform PR to make the proxy CIDR explicit in the egress module and add a unit test in the plan pipeline to fail if any proxy CIDR is omitted.

marta.sre: action items: ryan push toggle (done), jamie collect instance list + logs (in progress), leila run audit once logs available. postmortem draft by EOD.

jamie.infra: collecting logs now, will drop the compressed bundle in s3://redwood-temp/onboard-keystore-3555556666.tar.gz and link here.

ops-bot: upload complete: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-temp/onboard-keystore-3555556666.tar.gz

leila.security: saw the bundle, thanks. initial look: 3 misrouted proxies from the edge fleet that need subnet annotation fix. Will coordinate with edge team to push the patch and then we can remove the temporary CIDR allow.

marta.sre: marking incident as mitigated for provision-onboard. followups: tightened terraform guardrails, add plan-time test, audit retention exception doc, edge fleet subnet annotation fix.

ryan.platform: :thumbsup: will open the PRs and link.

jamie.infra: thanks team — closing thread once PRs merged and CIDR allow removed.
